THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Fire-Grilled Chicken Thighs + Frozen Veggies

One dry rub. One grill. Adult plate = 460 cal / 45g protein with 2 charred thighs and a hot-skillet frozen veggie side. Kid plate = same chicken with bread + dip. The frozen veggie IS the point — no chopping, no waste, weeknight leverage.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME25 min
COOK METHODGrill
EST. / SERVING~460 cal | ~45g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: PREHEAT GRILL FULL FLAME 5-10 MIN. Grates should hit 500°F+. The char is built in the first 60 sec of contact — cold grill = pale chicken.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 6 boneless skinless chicken thighs (2 per adult + 1 per kid)

FAT

  • Avocado oil spray (grill + skillet)

Option 1

  • 2 slices bread OR 2 dinner rolls (soft + familiar)
  • 2 tbsp dip of choice (garlic mayo, Alfredo, Smoky Chipotle Crema, Money Mustard, or bottled — pick the one kid trusts)

VEGGIES

  • 1 bag frozen vegetable blend (~3 servings — Birds Eye Blue Endeavors Garlic Herb baby-potato + green-bean blend shown; sub any freezer-staple blend)

DRY RUB (makes ~3 tbsp, for all 6 thighs)

  • 1 tbsp paprika
  • 1/2 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tbsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp dried oregano
  • 1 tsp cumin
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp brown sugar
  • 1/2 tsp cayenne

Allergens: gluten, dairy.

AT THE PLATE — same rub, same grill, same rest. Adult vs kid forks on portion (2 vs 1 thigh) + carb (veggies-only vs veggies + bread) + sauce (bare vs dip).

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.MIX RUB. Combine paprika + garlic powder + onion powder + oregano + cumin + salt + brown sugar + cayenne in a small bowl. Makes ~3 tbsp = enough for 6 thighs.
  2. 2.SEASON THIGHS. Pat 6 thighs dry with paper towel. Light spray of avocado oil. Sprinkle rub over both sides + edges. Rub in with gloved hands.
  3. 3.PREHEAT GRILL. Full-flame preheat 5-10 min until grates hit 500°F+. Oil the grates lightly with spray.
  4. 4.COOK VEGGIES. Preheat a skillet with 1 tbsp oil on medium-high 2 min. Dump the frozen blend in — no thawing. 6-8 min until hot + lightly browned. Season lightly if the blend is plain.
  5. 5.GRILL CHICKEN. Thighs onto the hot grill. 5-6 min per side, one flip. Chase char lines — visible dark grill marks + juices sizzling on the top surface.
  6. 6.REST + SLICE. Off the grill onto a cutting board, tent loosely with foil 3-5 min. Then slice against the grain into strips.

Adult — 2 Thighs + Frozen Veggies

  1. 7.ADULT PLATE. 2 sliced thighs + 1 serving frozen veggies. Bare — the rub + char is the flavor. Optional squeeze of lemon if you have one.

Kid — 1 Thigh + Half Veggies + Bread + Dip · Option 1

  1. 7.KID PLATE. 1 thigh chopped into kid-friendly pieces + 1/2 serving veggies + 1 slice bread or 1 dinner roll + 1 tbsp dip in a compartment tray or dip well. Chicken pieces small + dip within reach = maximum eating.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — 2 Thighs + Frozen Veggies: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — 1 Thigh + Half Veggies + Bread + Dip: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • PAT THIGHS DRY. Wet chicken doesn't crust. Blot with paper towel before oil + rub.
  • OIL FIRST, THEN RUB. Light spray of avocado oil helps the rub stick. Then the rub goes on both sides + edges.

If something fails

Chicken sticks to the grill: Grill wasn't hot enough, or the rub had too much sugar. Oil the grates before the chicken hits + wait for the grill to be fully preheated. Sugary rubs also need lower heat + longer cook — turn down to medium after the flip.

Frozen veggies are soggy: Pan wasn't hot enough OR too many veggies at once. Preheat the pan 2 min with oil first. Don't dump the whole bag — cook in 2 batches if needed.

Kid won't eat the chicken: Chop it small + serve the dip on the side. Kids eat chicken they can control — small pieces + dip-forward beats a big whole thigh on their plate every time.

Rub doesn't stick: Wet chicken. Pat dry with paper towel BEFORE seasoning. A light spray of oil helps too — the rub sticks to oil, not water.

Chicken looks charred outside but raw inside: Heat too high, too fast. Move to a cooler zone after the initial sear + finish covered with the grill lid down. Or drop temp to medium after 4 min per side.

Storage and reheating

Store: Leftover thighs + veggies hold well. Cool + refrigerate in airtight containers within 2 hr of cooking.

Reheat: Reheat chicken in a skillet or air fryer at 350°F × 4-5 min to preserve char. Microwave works too but softens the crust. Reheat veggies separately in a hot skillet 2 min.

Lasts: 3-4 days fridge. Freeze cooked chicken up to 2 months in portioned bags — thaw overnight, reheat as above.

Estimated nutrition

~460 cal | ~45g protein.

Brands I use

Birds Eye
Blue Endeavors Garlic Herb (frozen baby potatoes + green beans in garlic-herb sauce)
Freezer-staple veggie blend that skips all the chopping. 6-8 min from bag to plate in a hot skillet. Sub any frozen blend your kids will eat — Trader Joe's Fire-Roasted, 365 Organic, Cascadian Farm. The pattern is what matters, not the brand.
Chosen Foods
Avocado Oil Spray
Neutral high-smoke-point spray — right for grill grates + hot skillets. Also used on the chicken to help the rub stick.
